name: AirTrunk SYD2 expansion (Shell C/D)

address.value: 1 Sirius Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 1 SIRIUS ROAD LANE COVE WEST; the service returns two address points for this address (-33.80614,151.14840 and -33.80779,151.14472); first used. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: DPHI letter 23 Dec 2025 approving the updated CEMP 'prepared by AW Edwards Pty Ltd, dated 13 September 2025' and 'SYD2 CNVMP Update for MOD3 SSDA Construction Certificate Issue, prepared by AW Edwards Pty Ltd'. AW Edwards also built the initial phases. Tree Survey's 'EMCK3' (source 4, snippet) likely refers to AirTrunk's applicant entity EMKC, not the head contractor

mw_it.note: AirTrunk: '70-megawatt (MW) expansion ... the final two phases of SYD2 campus'. Phase 3 added '30MW of custom-built capacity' (completed Aug 2024, source 10), implying ~40 MW for phase 4 (not stated)

mw_grid.note: consent capacity 138 MW is for the whole SSD-9741 site (see airtrunk-syd2)

cost_aud_m.note: no separate CIV: phases 3-4 are within SSD-9741 (whole-building CIV $196.9m, see airtrunk-syd2); Mod 3 made no change to CIV

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (DPHI)
authority.note: Mod 3 determined by Director under delegation

pathway.note: phases 3-4 are part of the original SSD-9741 consent (four-phase building); Mod 3 changed design for the remaining phases

reference.note: parent consent SSD-9741 (determined 15 Nov 2019). Mod 3 'Design Changes': max height increase, data halls 18 to 20, chillers 106 to 108, transformers/generators 116 to 121; capacity 138 MW unchanged. Oct 2020 exhibition EXH-9395018 was Mod 2 (2 Apollo Place office), not this expansion

lodged.note: Mod 3 AR: 'The application was lodged on 14 February 2023'

determined.note: portal Determination Date 13/06/2024. Construction of the expansion started June 2023, before Mod 3 was determined, presumably under the existing SSD-9741 consent

jobs_construction.note: no separate figure; whole-SSD 'Approximately 320 direct construction jobs' (peak 320 on site) recorded on airtrunk-syd2

jobs_operational.note: no separate figure; whole-campus figures on airtrunk-syd2

construction_start.note: AirTrunk 15 Jun 2023: 'Construction commences for the final two phases of SYD2 campus'

construction_end.note: phase 3 (30 MW) completed Aug 2024 (AirTrunk 29 Aug 2024, source 10); phase 3 shell topped out Nov 2023 (source 13). Phase 4 not confirmed complete: DPHI approved an updated AW Edwards CEMP for Mod 3 construction on 23 Dec 2025 (source 12), so works continued into 2026. Original target was completion in 2024 (source 2)

open_questions: scope: excluded - split into airtrunk-syd2-phase3 and airtrunk-syd2-phase4 (decision 2026-09-27); removed from master.csv
